name: EverProX Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: EverProX Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of optical communication components in China and internationally. The company offers optical fibers and components, electronic components, optoelectronic devices and systems, and related technologies. It serves communication equipment manufacturers, telecom operators, and internet companies. The company was formerly known as Broadex Technologies Co., Ltd. and changed its name to EverProX Technologies Co., Ltd. in July 2025. EverProX Technologies Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Jiaxing, China.
